Signed coordinate symmetries yield x=(1,t)/(1+t³)^(1/3) and y=±(-t²,1)/(1+t⁶)^(1/3), t in [0,1]. Splitting at 8u³+7u−1=0 for u=t³ separates absolute-value branches. Independently rederived the degree-17 positive upper-branch Q from the resultant of implicit derivative of P_+(u) with F=(1+u²)^2*r³-u(1+u)^2, obtaining -27(u+1)^3(u²+1)^4*Q. Re-derived small-plus and negative resultant factors and checked exact Sturm root counts: Q one root in (0,1), small-plus zero in (0,7/50), negative one in (0,1). Actual derivative signs certify upper plus interior max and negative orientation only interior minimum, whose endpoints max 56^(1/6) is dominated by plus witness u=3/4. Thus exact isolated value 1.9639614189192027...; finite algebraic root counts and analytic global parametrization prove, not floating point.
